overview: 3D voxel characters (Sam Sinclair, Space Penguins, Chupacabra, Mothman, Loveland Frogman, and White Thang) built for The Sandbox, minted July 22nd, 2022 on The Sandbox's shared ASSET contract.
Primary sales settled in SAND on The Sandbox marketplace, off the ETH pipeline entirely. On-chain ETH secondary volume is negligible: only a couple sales for a fraction of an ETH.

They arrived inside Steve Aoki's wider Sandbox collection, which went live on The Sandbox Marketplace on September 25th, 2022 beside his own avatars, sneakers, gold records and jet, and buying any asset from it granted a Collector Badge worth 30 SAND. Aoki's Playhouse appeared in Sandbox Alpha Season 3 the same season.
